{"metadata":{"description":"A reliable coding agent for complex software engineering tasks.","id":"gh:1216785679","install_available":false,"language":"Go","name":"DeepSeek-Reasonix","slug":"esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix","topics":["agent","agent-framework","ai-agent","ai-coding","cli","coding-agent","deepseek","developer-tools","dsh","dsh-plugin","ink","llm","prompt-caching","r1","terminal","tool-use","tui","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A reliable coding agent for complex software engineering tasks."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"English"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Guide"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"ACP"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Extensions"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Spec"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Website"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Discord"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"QQ"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Open source · MIT · runs on your computer, model of your choice

>
> QQ group **DeepSeek-Reasoni"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"x官方群** (`1093562660`) → **<https://qm.qq.com/q/i59b0z2R8s>** (QR code)"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"> Douyin: **做游戏的小鱼** (Douyin ID `22703872788`) · QR code"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## What it is"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Reasonix is an open-source AI coding assistant. The program runs on your computer; the AI model is a"},{"id":"p15s2","text":" service you configure, which receives what it reads. You describe a task in plain language; it read"},{"id":"p15s3","text":"s code, edits files and runs commands and tests inside the project folder you choose, and shows you "},{"id":"p15s4","text":"its files and runs commands and tests inside the project folder you choose, and shows you each step."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"You pick the model: a DeepSeek preset is built in, any OpenAI-compatible service is one config entry"},{"id":"p16s2","text":", and you pay the model provider directly."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## What you get"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- **Read, edit, run.** It reads code, edits files and runs tests and commands, all inside your proje"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ct folder.
- **Permission levels.** Have it ask every time, or let everyday actions run on their own"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"; your forbid rules always hold. To see the approach first, use plan mode: it starts work only once "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"you approve.
- **Rewind.** A file is saved before it changes, so you can rewind by conversation turn"},{"id":"p18s5","text":" without touching your git history. Only files its edit tools changed are covered, not what a shell "},{"id":"p18s6","text":"ching your git history. Only files its edit tools changed are covered, not what a shell command did."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## 30-second start"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Download, add a model key, open a project. New here? Start with the Studio desktop app."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"1. Download and install the desktop app, Reasonix Studio, from the releases page.
2. Open it and ent"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"er your model provider and key when asked.
3. Open your project folder and write what you want, for "},{"id":"p21s3","text":"example "add retry on failure to the http client".
4. At the level you chose, it stops and asks befo"},{"id":"p21s4","text":"re anything that needs your say-so. Allow it to continue, or refuse."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Prefer a terminal? Download the `reasonix` command-line tool, run `reasonix setup` to pick a model, "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"then run `reasonix`. See Install and Quick start."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Four ways to use it"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Desktop app (Studio).** A graphical app; the best place to start.
- **Terminal.** A full-screen "},{"id":"p24s2","text":"text interface; `reasonix run "task"` also works in scripts.
- **Browser.** `reasonix web` opens a w"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"eb interface on your own machine.
- **Editor.** Install the extension in VS Code; other editors that"},{"id":"p24s4","text":" support ACP (Agent Client Protocol, a common way for an editor to connect to an AI assistant) can c"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"onnect to `reasonix acp`."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"All four are the same program underneath. What follows is for advanced users and contributors."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## Use it from DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) can hand a task to Reasonix as a subagent over ACP. This repository publish"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"es a plugin index for it:"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"1. Run `reasonix setup` on the machine that runs `dsh`. In the DSH Web UI turn on Custom plugin mark"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ets (Plugins, More) and add this index in the Discover tab: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/eseng"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/studio/integrations/dsh-plugin/market-index.json`
2. Install "Reasonix subagen"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"t" from it.
3. Open the plugin's page and turn its switch on. While it is off the model has no `reas"},{"id":"p28s5","text":"onix` tool and may run `reasonix -p` in its own shell, which looks like a delegation and is not one."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"Setup details, the permission policy and limits are in Using Reasonix from DeepSeek Harness."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Versions"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Reasonix ships on two lines. See the version roadmap announcement for the reasoning behind the split"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"easonix ships on two lines. See the version roadmap announcement for the reasoning behind the split."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"| Line | Branch | Status | Get it |"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| **Reasonix 2.x** | `studio` (this branch) | Active development | Studio releases |
| **Reasonix 1."},{"id":"p33s2","text":"x** | `main-v2` | Maintenance / stable | `npm i -g reasonix` · desktop download |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"- **Want something stable?** Stay on 1.x. It keeps receiving bug fixes,
provider/API compatibility, "},{"id":"p34s2","text":"updater and security fixes; its core architecture
is no longer being extended.
- **Want the new arch"},{"id":"p34s3","text":"itecture?** Use 2.x Reasonix Studio. It is still moving
quickly; reports are welcome."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Valuable fixes, tests and behaviour from 1.x are reviewed one by one and ported
or reimplemented on "},{"id":"p35s2","text":"2.x where they fit the new architecture."},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- Moving from 1.x to 2.x: what the two lines share, and
how to run both on one machine without losin"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"g sessions.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"Technical highlights for advanced users."},{"id":"p39s1","text":"- **Config-driven.** Providers, the agent, enabled tools, and plugins are all
declared in `reasonix."},{"id":"p39s2","text":"toml`. No hardcoded models.
- **Multi-model & composable.** DeepSeek ships as a preset; any
OpenAI-c"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"ompatible endpoint is a config entry, not new code. Optionally run
two models together (executor + p"},{"id":"p39s4","text":"lanner) in separate, cache-stable sessions.
- **Plugin-driven.** MCP servers contribute tools, promp"},{"id":"p39s5","text":"ts, and resources;
Extension Protocol v1 sidecars can also intercept runtime events, contribute
Prov"},{"id":"p39s6","text":"iders and structured UI, and ship versioned plugin packages.
- **Cache-aware context maintenance.** "},{"id":"p39s7","text":"Startup injects a small stable environment
summary, stale tool output is snipped/pruned before summa"},{"id":"p39s8","text":"ry compaction, and the
built-in tool schema contract is documented for regression review.
- **Zero-f"},{"id":"p39s9","text":"riction distribution.** `CGO_ENABLED=0` single binary; cross-compile
to six targets with one command"},{"id":"p39s10","text":". The result is a fully self-contained static
binary — nothing to install on the target machine beyo"},{"id":"p39s11","text":"nd the binary itself."}],"truncated":true}
